adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Jobs::RetrieveTopic < Jobs::Base` does not set `sidekiq_options retry: false` (unlike the new `Jobs::PollFeed` which explicitly disables retries). `execute` calls `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve` without rescuing network/parse exceptions. `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` may run `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` and then `fetch_http` -> `TopicEmbed.import_remote` -> `open(url).read`, which can raise (404, encoding, etc.). With Sidekiq’s default retry behavior, a permanently failing `embed_url` would be retried many times over time, and because `retrieved_recently?` only throttles for 60 seconds via Redis, retries occurring later will re-fetch again.
